package.description: The first read-it-later app built for power readers

en-US.author: Readwise, Inc.
en-US.description: The first read-it-later app built for power readers
en-US.longDescription:
Save everything to one place to overcome content overload, search instantly, and highlight like a pro.

All your reading in one place. No more juggling dozens of reading apps. Just one: we call it Reader.

- Web highlighting: freely highlight and annotate the open web using the Reader browser extension.
- RSS: easily subscribe to the RSS feeds of your favorite websites in Reader to never miss a post.
- PDFs: upload yours to Reader to finally get through that forgotten folder, with full-text search.
en-US.name: Readwise Reader

zh-CN.description: 首款面向重度读者的"稍后读"应用
zh-CN.longDescription:
将所有内容保存到一处，克服信息过载，即时搜索，像专业人士一样标注。

所有阅读汇聚一处。无需在几十个阅读应用之间来回切换，只需要一个：我们称之为 Reader。

- 网页标注：使用 Reader 浏览器扩展，在开放的网页上自由划线标注。
- RSS：在 Reader 中轻松订阅你喜爱网站的 RSS 源，不错过任何更新。
- PDF：把 PDF 上传到 Reader，通过全文搜索彻底读完那个被遗忘的文件夹。
